approved: Electoral Amendment (Banning Foreign Political Donations) Bill 2017
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would ban political parties and candidates from taking donations from foreign sources.
It would make donors give a statutory declaration saying they are not a foreign person, with an offence still applying if they are.
A gift over $1,000 would require the declaration at the time of giving, which is stricter than the current name and address rules for gifts over $10,000.
Makes it an offence for a political party or candidate to accept a foreign donation.
Requires the donor to submit a statutory declaration confirming they are not a foreign person.
Adds a requirement for the declaration to be provided at the time of the gift.
Political parties, candidates, and foreign donors.
